articles.summary: AptarGroup, Inc. (NYSE: ATR), a global leader in drug delivery, dosing and protection technologies, and consumer product dispensing, today announced the appointment of Virginie Maes as President of Aptar Pharma, effective January 1, 2027. Aptar Taps Pharma Packaging Veteran Virginie Maes as President of its Pharma Business Maes joins Aptar from Amcor, where she currently leads its global Flexibles Pharma and Medical packaging business, spanning North America, Latin America, EMEA and Asia. During her career at Amcor, she has held senior leadership roles across pharma, medical, strategy and business development. She brings extensive experience in global customer relationships, growth and transformation, operational performance and building highly engaged teams. Earlier in her career, Maes worked at McKinsey Company, Terra Firma Capital Partners and Morgan Stanley. articles.summary: AptarGroup, Inc. (NYSE: ATR), a global leader in drug delivery, dosing and protection technologies, and consumer product dispensing, today announced that its Board of Directors declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.50 per share, an increase of approximately 4% from the previous quarterly dividend of $0.48 per share. The payment date is December 3, 2026, to stockholders of record as of November 12, 2026. “Increasing our dividend to $0.50 per share puts Aptar on track for its 33rd consecutive year of paying an annually increasing dividend and reflects our confidence in the Company’s future growth,” said Gael Touya, President and Chief Executive Officer. “As we invest in the business to drive profitable growth, we remain focused on disciplined capital allocation and creating sustainable, long-term value for our shareholders.” About Aptar Aptar is a global leader in drug delivery, dosing and protection technologies, and consumer product dispensing.
